title: Private-chest
description: a simple mod which will lock your chest from your ur friends
body:
1. A simple mod which let's you lock your chest from friends and unwanted .visitors 
2. it only works for server side ONLY 
3. fabric-api required  
4. how to use ?:- stand on chest u want to lock and type /private and the cords of chest or simpily tab 3 times to lock it 
5. KNOW ISSUE - you need to lock both chest on a  double chest or it will not lock properly
